title: High Contrast Fix（高对比度修复）
description: Added high-contrast style textures for Mods./为模组添加高对比度材质。
body:
# Original Intention
Mojang added a "High Contrast" resource pack on 1.19.4 to help people with color weakness etc. play Minecraft more easily.
But most of Mods doesn't look to support it. That's such a Problem.
So I made this, for helping them play Mods better.
# Supported Mods
- [OpenLink](https://modrinth.com/mod/openlink)
- [In-game account swicher(IAS)](https://modrinth.com/mod/in-game-account-switcher)
- [Just enough items(JEI)](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)
- Virtual keybinder
- (No Yet hahaha, working rapidly)
